title: Senior Software Developer (Graphics)
descriptionHeader: Building graphics, visualization and CAD tooling
description: As a Senior Software Developer (Graphics) at Watoga, you will be responsible for developing, testing, and maintaining software applications, focusing on front-end web development and programming (React + ThreeJS). This role is primarily responsible for programming a drill-n-blast CAD & editing application using ThreeJS.
note: You don't need mining or drilling experience to excel in this role.
responsibilities: Design graphics, visualization and CAD tooling to integrate with our drill and blast plan design application
Architect and ensure reliability of the rendering and graphics of the CAD scene
Work to make the design files exported to other CAD software
Build out integrations with other CAD software and implement systems for robust geometric representation of objects in the CAD scene
competencies: Extensive experience with graphics, visualization and CAD tooling
Experience in several of the following languages and frameworks: React, ThreeJS, Electron, Python, CAD, C++, Rust, Bevy, etc.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Good communication and collaboration skills
Habit of writing clean and documented code
Experience diagnosing complex graphics, visualization and CAD issues
Experience in the mining industry is a plus
inThisRoleYouWill: Own a product vertical with the opportunity to build a team around yourself over time
Work directly with our internal and external customers to drive our roadmap
Get to build alongside the best engineers and mining operators in the world
Be given autonomy and virtually unlimited room to grow
Travel all over the world
thisMightBeAGoodFitIfYou: Have a bias to action, take pride in your work, and care more about getting to the right solution than being right
Have led critical projects or initiatives

title: Senior Backend Developer
descriptionHeader: Building data pipelines and backend services
description: As a Senior Backend Developer at Watoga, you will play a key role in shaping the backbone of our systems, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance across our platforms.
note: You don't need mining or drilling experience to excel in this role.
responsibilities: Architect, implement, and maintain backend services and data pipelines with a focus on scalability and fault tolerance.
Deal with and clean up operational data from sensors and mining equipment to feed into our models
Design and optimize relational database schemas, queries, and indexes using PostgreSQL.
Develop and tune geospatial queries for advanced location-based use cases.
Work with cloud-native infrastructure, primarily Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Collaborate with frontend, DevOps, and product teams to deliver robust APIs and high-performance systems.
Build monitoring, testing, and deployment pipelines to support a rapid development cycle with IaC (Terraform).
Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical roadmap discussions.
competencies: Considerable experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of building large-scale, production-grade systems.
Strong expertise with PostgreSQL (query optimization, schema design, performance tuning).
Experience with geospatial databases/queries (PostGIS or similar).
Professional experience with GCP and/or AWS services for backend and data engineering workloads.
Solid programming skills in at least one of: Python (FastAPI), C++, Rust or Node.js.
Familiarity with distributed systems, messaging queues, and stream processing.
Strong grasp of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently as well as in cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description: As a Senior Electrical Engineer at Watoga, you will design and implement sensors and systems to survey and gather data on production blast benches. You will also be responsible for the design and implementation of the sensors and systems that power and control our sensor platform.
note: You don't need mining or drilling experience to excel in this role.
responsibilities: Design electrical layouts and schematics for sensor platforms, including power distribution, controls, and instrumentation
Ensure proper data collection and calibration from sensors and systems
Specify and source electrical components (switchgear, VFDs, PLCs, sensors, cables) aligned with rig requirements
Develop wiring diagrams, harness routings, and cabinet layouts, ensuring maintainability and compliance
Coordinate with controls/software teams to integrate I/O points, safety circuits, and communication networks
Perform load calculations, short-circuit/arc flash analysis, and ensure systems meet relevant codes (NEC, NFPA)
Provide field support for commissioning, troubleshooting, and iterative improvements
competencies: Extensive experience with industrial electrical systems, panel design, and power distribution
Proficiency with CAD tools for electrical design (e.g., EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, SolidWorks Electrical)
Knowledge of PLC I/O wiring, instrumentation selection, and grounding/shielding best practices
Familiarity with relevant standards (NEC, UL508A, CE) and safe working practices
Comfortable working with cross-functional teams to integrate mechanical and controls aspects
Experience diagnosing complex electrical issues in demanding field environments

title: Embedded Systems Developer
description: We are hiring an embedded systems developer to develop low-level firmware for sensors, microcontrollers, and communication systems on our sensor platform. You’ll rapidly prototype, iterate, and collaborate with the rest of our team, testing in the field daily or weekly.
responsibilities: Develop and optimize firmware for embedded microcontrollers and industrial-grade equipment
Integrate and calibrate diverse sensors for real-time data acquisition and control loops
Ensure reliable, timing-critical firmware operation in rugged environments, supporting closed-loop automation
Connect embedded devices to networks (e.g., Starlink) for remote data capture
Collaborate with mechanical and electrical engineers to align hardware and software integrations from PCB to actuator
Iterate quickly on firmware and sensor configurations in both lab and field environments
competencies: Experience in embedded firmware development, ideally in industrial or heavy machinery contexts
Strong understanding of real-time operating systems, control algorithms (e.g., PID), and sensor fusion
Skilled at sensor integration, signal conditioning, and data processing for actionable insights
Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (CAN bus, Modbus) and wireless solutions
Proven ability to maintain robustness in challenging conditions (dust, vibration, extreme temperatures)
Comfortable in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary team environment, rapidly prototyping, testing, and refining code for field-ready performance
